lines.text: Most inquiries don't fail. They stall between the first message and the estimate.
Step one: reply in minutes, by text and call, while they're still looking.
Step two: ask three quick questions, so you know it's a real job.
Step three: offer two times, and book the estimate on the spot.
Then confirm and remind, so they actually show up.
Want to see where yours stall? Request a review from Elevate Home Ads.
